name: lua51
description: Lua 5.1.5 for the Redis gateway's scripts (.kiro/specs/redis-general-data-types/ Requirement 30): the copy Valkey ships in deps/lua, with its security fixes, read-only tables and the cjson, cmsgpack, bit and struct libraries Redis scripts expect, Valkey's fpconv_dtoa (number arguments of redis.call), plus Kythira's patch that makes number formatting and number-to-integer conversion the same on amd64 and arm64. Built as C with a vendored CMakeLists, exported as lua51::lua51.
